A clear conversation

Five steps to get oriented.

Admissions can guide you through programme requirements, current intake information and the application steps for your chosen course.

Start an enquiry
01

Explore the courses

Compare the nine programmes in Nursing, Rehabilitation & Physiotherapy, Medical Laboratory Sciences, Radiology & Imaging, Pharmacy, Optometry and Healthcare Support.

Explore academics →
02

Review the fee structure

Use the course-by-course fee tables where published, including tuition, admission, security, uniform and total amounts.

View fees →
03

Send your enquiry

Share your name, contact details, city, course interest and question so the admissions office can respond directly.

Enquire now →
04

Confirm current requirements

Ask admissions about the current intake, eligibility, documents, fees and any course-specific steps before submitting an application.

05

Complete the advised application steps

Follow the institution's latest instructions for the programme you select. Keep your enquiry confirmation and fee information for reference.
